papers.title: Low-Latency Alerts of Massive Black Hole Binaries in LISA
papers.summary: TRUFFLE uses transformer-conditioned normalizing flows for simulation-based inference of massive black hole binaries in LISA, providing rapid calibrated alerts robust to overlapping sources.

papers.title: Feature redundancy, redshift, and class-prior effects in SDSS--WISE photometric classification
papers.summary: Five classifiers are evaluated on 3.65 million SDSS-WISE sources across feature scenarios, showing redshift dominates photometric galaxy-quasar-star classification and internal photo-z is redundant.

papers.title: EuclidFM: Foundation Model for Compact Photometric Survey Representation
papers.summary: EuclidFM trains a masked-autoencoder Transformer on 90,258 Euclid catalogue sources, producing embeddings that predict VIS magnitudes and flag quasar candidates with uncertain transferability.

papers.title: Simulation-based inference for gravitational-wave cosmology: parameter reconstruction of a first-order electroweak phase transition
papers.summary: Simulation-based inference reconstructs first-order electroweak phase-transition parameters from a stochastic gravitational-wave background, matching MCMC posteriors at negligible per-dataset cost after training.
